name: TOTP Sign-In
summary: Authenticates an identified durable identity with TOTP and adapts the accepted proof to either the web session path or the mobile token path.

sourceReferences.note: AuthenticateWithTotpAsync adapts accepted proof to the real SignInManager web session path; AuthenticateWithTotpTokenAsync adapts the same proof to the existing single-use-token access/refresh-token pipeline for mobile.
Both session adapters share one typed TOTP proof handler and canonical transition family.
